nodes.name: IB.md
nodes.summary: Guide to connecting pysystemtrade to Interactive Brokers, covering Gateway/TWS setup, establishing a broker connection, and a reference of the IB data source, client, and connection objects.
nodes.languageNotes: Mixes setup walkthrough with an API object reference describing the brokers.ib package structure (data source, client, connection objects).

nodes.name: backtesting.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive 'How do I?' guide to the simulation engine, covering trading rules, building standard and parameter-estimating futures backtests, configuration, stages, and inspecting results across the systems framework.
nodes.languageNotes: Very large (4670 lines) cookbook-style reference organized as ~178 task-oriented headings spanning the entire sysquant/systems simulation stack.

nodes.name: dashboard_and_monitor.md
nodes.summary: Short guide to the web dashboard and system monitor used in production, including handling of crashed processes and running a remote dashboard/monitor.

nodes.name: data.md
nodes.summary: End-to-end guide to the futures data workflow (instrument config, roll calendars, multiple and back-adjusted prices, FX data) and an overview of the data storage object hierarchy and directory structure.
nodes.languageNotes: Two-part structure: a hands-on data ingestion workflow followed by an architectural overview of the sysdata storage and access object hierarchy.

nodes.name: installation.md
nodes.summary: Installation guide for pysystemtrade describing project file layout and two environment-setup paths (pyenv + venv, or uv), plus a verification test.

nodes.name: instruments.md
nodes.summary: Explains the different instrument sets used across sampling, simulation, and production, how the instrument list is defined and customised, and constraints like reduce-only and exclusion of 'bad' markets.

nodes.name: introduction.md
nodes.summary: Beginner-friendly introduction that builds up from a simple trading rule to a complete pre-baked system, demonstrating config from dictionaries and files along the way.

nodes.name: list_of_futures_product_pages.md
nodes.summary: Reference list of futures product pages (exchange/product links) used as a lookup when adding or configuring tradable instruments.

nodes.name: production.md
nodes.summary: Definitive guide to running pysystemtrade as a live production system, covering data flow, broker linkage, data storage and backup, logging and reporting, and position/order management at instrument and contract level.
nodes.languageNotes: Largest production reference (4074 lines, ~122 sections) spanning the full sysproduction stack from quick start to order management and reconciliation.

nodes.name: production_strategy_changes.md
nodes.summary: Step-by-step runbook for changing a live strategy: adding instruments, creating custom strategy classes, updating config and capital, transferring positions, adjusting limits, and restarting processes.
